descriptionChirho: The proper noun designating the region (and its chief city) in central Palestine between Judea and Galilee, significant in the NT as the homeland of the Samaritans and a key mission field (Acts 1:8, 8:1-14; John 4:4-7). All 11 occurrences refer to the same geographical entity across various grammatical cases (nominative, genitive, dative, accusative). Multilingual evidence is uniform: Swahili 'Samaria/Samareia', Hindi 'Samariya', Korean 'Samaria', Arabic 'al-Samira/Samira', Spanish 'Samaria/Samareia'. The S76325 cluster (3x, genitive) is a purely case-driven split from S76324 (8x, genitive/dative/nominative/accusative) with identical referent and no semantic distinction.
